technology_name: Value Added Syrups from Palm Neera and Coconut Neera
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Limited value-added utilization of palm and coconut sap
description: This technology produces syrups from palm and coconut sap that can be used for sweetening beverages and food products. The process can also be adapted for sugar-free syrup production using sugarcane juice and sugar substitutes. The products are prepared without preservatives and use various additives only for clarification and solidification purposes.
applications:
Coconut and palm sap processing enterprises
Natural sweetener and specialty ingredient manufacturers
Beverage, bakery, and confectionery product companies
Health food, wellness, and nutraceutical brands
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agri-entrepreneurs engaged in value-added palm and coconut products
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
